title: Exploring Visual Culture Awareness in GPT-4V: A Comprehensive Probing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's visual cultural awareness using the MaRVL dataset across five diverse cultures (Indonesian, Mandarin Chinese, Swahili, Tamil, and Turkish) through caption classification, pairwise image captioning, and multi-choice culture tag selection tasks.

Comparing the model's performance disparities between high-resource languages (e.g., Chinese) and low-resource languages (e.g., Tamil, Swahili) across vision-language reasoning and description generation tasks.
